elements.text: Beta-blockers are a first-line therapy for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
This guideline summarizes dosing recommendations for adults.

elements.caption: Table 1. Recommended starting and target doses
elements.markdown:
| Drug | Starting dose | Target dose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Metoprolol succinate | 12.5-25 mg once daily | 200 mg once daily |
| Carvedilol | 3.125 mg twice daily | 25-50 mg twice daily |
| Bisoprolol | 1.25 mg once daily | 10 mg once daily |

elements.caption_original: Figure 1. Titration flowchart for beta-blocker initiation
elements.vlm_description: A flowchart showing four sequential steps from initial low-dose beta-blocker prescription through gradual up-titration with heart rate and blood pressure checks at each step.

elements.text: Patients should be monitored for bradycardia and hypotension during up-titration.
